definitions.explanation: Newspaper treated as a physical material — the paper itself, especially when reused for wrapping, cleaning, crafts, or recycling. Distinct from 新聞, which refers to the newspaper as a publication.

examples.english: To wipe the windows with newspaper.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}、⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新聞紙|しんぶんし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包|つつ}んだ→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: When moving, I wrapped the dishes in newspaper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新聞紙|しんぶんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The children used newspaper to make hats in their arts and crafts class.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧ (newspaper) + {紙|し} (paper). While ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧ refers to the newspaper as a publication to read, {新聞紙|しんぶんし} emphasizes the physical paper material. This distinction is important in everyday Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新聞紙|しんぶんし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to wrap in newspaper
- {新聞紙|しんぶんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to spread newspaper (as a mat)
- {新聞紙|しんぶんし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧: to wipe with newspaper
- ⟦{古|ふる}→古〜：03966_furu⟧{新聞紙|しんぶんし}: old newspapers (for recycling/reuse)

PRACTICAL USES IN JAPAN:
Newspaper is widely reused for practical purposes: cleaning windows and mirrors (a popular household tip), wrapping fragile items during moves, absorbing moisture in shoes, lining pet cages, and protecting surfaces during painting.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧: newspaper — the publication itself, what you read
- ⟦{古紙|こし}→古紙：21849_koshi⟧: waste paper — broader term for paper to be recycled
- ⟦チラシ→チラシ：23406_chirashi⟧: flyer, advertising insert — the leaflets inserted into newspapers
